description: Every message a DSTNS daemon can send, as templates: the enum the daemons and their readers share. {name} is filled in from the message's data. Levels, lowest first: info, warning, alert, emergency. Alerts and emergencies go to daemonEmergencyQueue; the rest to daemonNotificationQueue.

rcs.below_alpha.title: {module} is using less than it should
rcs.below_alpha.text: {module} has used {value} {unit} of {metric} for {sustain_s} s, below its α of {alpha} {unit}. Something may be off: is it working properly?

rcs.over_beta.title: {module} is using a lot of {metric}
rcs.over_beta.text: {module} has used {value} {unit} of {metric} for {sustain_s} s, over its β of {beta} {unit}. Its limit, γ, is {gamma} {unit}.

rcs.over_gamma.title: {module} is over its {metric} limit
rcs.over_gamma.text: {module} has used {value} {unit} of {metric} for {sustain_s} s, over its γ, the most it should ever use, of {gamma} {unit}.

rcs.recovered.title: {module} is back within its {metric} limits
rcs.recovered.text: {module} uses {value} {unit} of {metric} again, between its α of {alpha} and β of {beta} {unit}.

memory.low.title: This machine is low on memory
memory.low.text: {available_mib} MiB of {total_mib} MiB is available ({available_percent}%). Close what is not needed.

memory.critical.title: This machine is out of memory
memory.critical.text: Only {available_mib} MiB of {total_mib} MiB is available ({available_percent}%). Programs may be stopped by the system at any moment.

disk.low.title: Disk space is low
disk.low.text: {free_mib} MiB is free where DSTNS keeps its logs and maps. The cache handler is clearing what it can.

disk.critical.title: The disk is almost full
disk.critical.text: Only {free_mib} MiB is free where DSTNS keeps its logs and maps. Logs, checkpoints and downloads may fail.

engine.stalled.title: The simulation has stopped moving
engine.stalled.text: The run is meant to be running, but its clock has not moved for {stalled_s} s.

cache.swept.title: The cache was cleaned
cache.swept.text: {removed} files, {freed_mib} MiB, that nothing needed any more. The map cache is {cache_mib} MiB.
